instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/rest_shape.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Create FreeCAD Path/CAM rest machining. First use T1 to clear the main pocket, then use T2 to machine all small-radius corners and narrow remaining regions. The target floor is Z=6.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a clearing end mill; T2 is a smaller rest-machining end mill. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-08.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
